Typst now edits like tinymist, with source and a live preview side by side.
Editing, dialogs and saving behave more like VS Code, and saving can no
longer silently overwrite changes made outside Malgel. More at
[www.malgel.com](https://www.malgel.com).

## New

- **Typst live preview.** A `.typ` file opens as editable, highlighted
  source next to a live preview. It compiles incrementally in the
  background, keeps the last good pages while there are errors, underlines
  errors in the source, and offers a clickable error banner. Click the
  preview to jump to the source.
- **Color theme… picker** in the command palette, also on Ctrl+K Ctrl+T.
- **Ctrl+P recently opened.** An empty Quick Open lists recently opened files first.
- **Line numbers like VS Code.** The gutter sits at the pane's left edge. Click
  or drag line numbers to select whole lines, including in wrapped files and
  after scrolling.
- **Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes** on Linux and Windows (Ctrl+Y still works).
- **Find** outlines the other matches so they are easy to spot.

## Fixed

- **Disk conflicts can't lose data.** The "changed on disk" dialog takes keyboard
  focus, and Ctrl+S no longer silently overwrites a newer version on disk.
- **Read-only files** are refused with a clear error and Save As. Symlinks and
  hard links stay intact when saved.
- **Dialogs take keyboard focus.** Enter, Esc and Tab act on the dialog, not the document behind it.
- **File dialogs that cannot open** (no xdg-desktop-portal) show an error instead of doing nothing.
- One Esc closes Find in Files, the palette and Quick Open. Ctrl+Shift+F reopens
  with the last query.
- Switching layouts or resizing panes keeps the caret line. Go to Line centers the line.
- Line numbers meet 4.5:1 contrast in all 19 themes. The dark theme has a clearer selection
  and current line.
- Reopening a folder restores all its tabs. Session text loads off the UI thread.
- UTF-16 files open, binary files get a clearer dialog, and loading tabs show for PDFs, images and Typst.
- Mermaid edge labels get a background that fits their text.
- The CLI rejects unknown options. A launch goes only to the Malgel in the same session.
